answer: Milestone voyage bonds block fake identities. Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and sails a three-leg voyage: a mesa departure, key-sealed island crossing, and closing filing. Auditors recompute legs from the mesa and island logs; copied or skipped legs burn bonds. The k-th filing costs 42+6(k-1); a thousand fakes burn 3,039,000 fees and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented-voyage rings fail; honest agents sail once, pay 42, keep the bond.
